topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Ran into a little snag, didn't see this one coming. Got a letter, couldn't ignore it—building's going condo. Rent's been steady, peace and quiet, but those days are numbered. Money talks, and it's shouting loud down at the management office. Folks are whispering different names, different deals. Maybe it's just the rain, makes you think the sky's leaking secrets. Could be a quick flip, or maybe someone's in deep and needs a way out. Gotta keep my eyes open, see who's sniffing around, who's got that gleam. Ain't easy to untangle the web once it's spun, but I've got to find out who’s orchestrating this change. Old habits die hard, especially when the stakes are as high as they are now.
